1 .Yes, this model was developed for DOT parachaining by the community over a series of calls last February. The original thread is linked in the summary at the top. 
2. Yes, it is out of date, hence a need for re-review and my notes that it is from February. 
3. Yes, the purpose of this thread is to perform a review and nuevo analysis. 

**Update:** I've added a new copy and linked to the original post, and updated the network metrics.

a bunch of things don't feel right to me here

- is this for DOT? it seems out of date
- extraneous or misleading figures (average supply? reward per circulating supply? etc)
- KSM chains seem to be taking far more dilution to be bonded (including KPHA which is based off mainnet PHA)


the original spreadsheet is somewhat more informative but I don't really trust the quality of the synthesis - we should run through a new analysis.
